name: Sirius
source:
"I'll protect the little princess. This is also part of a knights teachings."

A dragon knight that protects the sacred dragon valley.
A bit of a formal guy who lives for his mission, he is overflowing with justice.
A gentlemanly and polite guy who is very helpful.
He's always together with the silver dragon [url=/c43694]Truce[/url].
